$comment: O28A: the reproducible local deployment of the Kauro api, declared. tools: Node and pnpm as package.json pins them; PostgreSQL 17 from PGBIN, a fresh cluster (initdb, loopback only) with the runtime roles and every migration applied by the migrator role. The api runs as one process, `node apps/api/dist/src/main.js`, with exactly the environment below (placeholders in ${...} are filled by the runner: the cluster port, a free HTTP port, and the LOCAL bearer-token file of one synthetic person it writes). No provider, no credential, no remote host: the database is 127.0.0.1, the HTTP listener is 127.0.0.1, every provider port is a labelled contract fake or unbound. apps/api/test/o28a/local-deploy.test.ts deploys it, probes it, redeploys it and fails it.
egress: loopback only: the database and the listener are 127.0.0.1; the api binds no provider (apps/api/test/o28a/cross-tenant-sweep.test.ts observes every outbound socket)
backup: pg_dumpall --roles-only + pg_dump -Fc of the kauro database; restore: initdb, roles file, pg_restore -C (apps/api/test/o28a/continuity.test.ts)
rollback: migrations are forward-only: a rollback redeploys the previous build against the same database when its migrations are a prefix of the applied ledger, otherwise restores the pre-deploy backup and redeploys the previous build (docs/operations/STAGE-A-OPERATIONS.md)
